cards.card_text: Leah's oldest boy, Reuben, goes out into the field and finds some mandrakes.
cards.verse_text: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field.
cards.snippet: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field.

cards.card_text: Reuben brings the mandrakes to his aunt Rachel.
cards.verse_text: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field.
cards.snippet: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field.

cards.card_text: Rachel begs Leah for some of her son's mandrakes.
cards.verse_text: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field.
cards.snippet: Now during the wheat harvest, Reuben went out and found some mandrakes in the field.

cards.card_text: What does Rachel offer her in exchange for the mandrakes?
cards.verse_text: Now you want to take my son’s mandrakes as well?” “Very well,” said Rachel, “he may sleep with you tonight in exchange for your son’s mandrakes.”
cards.snippet: Now you want to take my son’s mandrakes as well?” “Very well,” said Rachel, “he may sleep with you tonight…

cards.card_text: That evening Leah meets Jacob coming in from the field and says, “You must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night.
cards.verse_text: When Jacob came in from the field that evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, “You must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night.
cards.snippet: …must come with me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” So he slept with her that night.

cards.card_text: Even the mandrakes are sending out their fragrance.
cards.verse_text: The mandrakes send forth a fragrance, and at our door is every delicacy, new as well as old, that I have treasured up for you, my beloved.
cards.snippet: The mandrakes send forth a fragrance, and at our door is every delicacy, new…

cards.card_text: Along with the fragrance of the mandrakes, what does the young woman say is at their door?
